backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing hubs, posts, predictions, team data, player ratings, and a timed news ticker using ordered maps and blob storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing removed publish‑help UI elements, affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files describing their roles, UI behavior, and feature implementations.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app router configuring all pages and wrapping them in a dark theme and toaster provider.
frontend/src/components/AuthDialog.tsx: User authentication dialog supporting guest mode and account creation with avatar selection and local/session storage persistence.
frontend/src/components/EmojiPicker.tsx: Popover emoji picker organized by categories that inserts selected emojis into user input.
frontend/src/components/HighlightsTab.ts: Manages uploading, displaying, and voting on image highlights with localStorage persistence and weekly top-highlight compilation.
frontend/src/components/NewsTickerBar.ts: Displays an auto‑scrolling news ticker with team‑based styling and a refresh action using query hooks.
frontend/src/components/PlayerRating.tsx: Provides a star‑based player rating UI that saves user ratings locally and submits them to the backend while showing average ratings.
frontend/src/components/PointsTracker.ts: Shows total user points, determines their tier, and presents a dialog with tier details and point breakdown.
frontend/src/components/SharedHubModal.t: Modal prompting users to join a shared hub as guest or registered user, with optional remembered login preference.
frontend/src/components/ShareToSocial.ts: Toggle to simulate sharing a comment to multiple social platforms and log the action in localStorage.
Displays recent shared social‑buzz entries from localStorage with platform icons in a scrollable panel.
frontend/src/components/TeamOfTheWeekBui: UI component to select up to 11 players, generate a saved team of the week, and manage selection via modal dialog.
frontend/src/components/TeamVisualTempla: Displays team visuals using predefined logo and player data mapped by team name.
frontend/src/components/UserProfile.tsx: User profile dropdown showing account info, points, share-hub link generator, and logout handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identities, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for hubs, dashboard data, fixtures, posts, predictions, and news.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global fonts, Tailwind layers, color variables for light/dark themes, and animation utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider, rendering the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseHubs.tsx: Displays a list of predefined sports teams and lets users select one to create or switch their hub.
frontend/src/pages/ChatInterface.tsx: Implements a chat-driven interface for managing hubs, posts, predictions, fixtures, and news with interactive message flow.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Shows team-specific dashboard data with tabs for posts, predictions, news, and fixtures, along with creation and interaction tools.
frontend/src/pages/FanCommunityPage.tsx: Provides a team-based community feed where users select a team and post comments, fetching related section data.
frontend/src/pages/FanLeaderboardPage.ts: Generates mock leaderboard data, renders rankings with tier icons, and provides a weekly summary with navigation home.
frontend/src/pages/FanPredictionsPage.ts: Allows users to select or enter a team, view AI‑generated prediction content, and post predictions via mutations.
frontend/src/pages/IntroScreen.tsx: Empty placeholder page with no content.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Handles initial auth flow, shared hub link logic, and displays the main landing interface with modals.
frontend/src/pages/LiveFixturesPage.tsx: Displays upcoming fixtures for a selected team, parses fixture text formats, and lets users post comments.
frontend/src/pages/PublishHelpPage.tsx: Empty placeholder page with no content.
frontend/src/pages/TeamNewsPage.tsx: Lets users pick or enter a team and loads AI‑generated team news content with navigation options.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content paths, extended theme colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks project state and features, documenting removal of the in-app publishing help flow and related UI/routes as out of scope.
